```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
history <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet")
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = case_when(
      outcome == "YES" ~ 1L,
      outcome == "NO" ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(substr(resolved_at, 1, 10)) - date),
    horizon = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution > 0 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    horizon = factor(
      horizon,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket = horizon) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prediction_error = mean(absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_prediction_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time to resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "Forecast probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = cut(
      probability,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
      labels = paste0(seq(0, 90, by = 10), "-", seq(10, 100, by = 10), "%"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_probability = mean(probability, na.rm = TRUE),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(market_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(calibration, aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate, size = n)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "High-probability final-day forecasts usually resolve YES",
    x = "Mean predicted probability",
    y = "Actual resolution rate",
    size = "Markets in bin"
  )
```
